protocol.status: Exploratory prototype with declared numerical checks; no replacement of primary menu or automatic service approval
protocol.motivation: A one-step growth gate can reject a fee that pays off over several years. The paired annual-vs-hold ablation shows that fewer trades can raise full-horizon drawdown risk. Study horizon-consistent fee accounting on a small frozen-target family before any new joint optimization.
protocol.data_history: Only guarded scenarios 1--120. Previously seen V1 final scenarios 121--180 are forbidden. Development data are reused. This protocol is prospective for this new prototype calculation, not preregistration on unseen data.
protocol.targets: Freeze the three alpha10 risk_only annual-policy targets in each full/96-scenario fold fit. Do not refit menus, risk budgets, target weights or customer assignment based on prototype results. The exact-third annual baseline is a comparison only.

forecast.sample: Only the current training context: 120 full-development or 96 fold-training complete 30-year scenarios. Equal weight per original scenario and equal weight per year within each path; use all joint three-asset annual gross vectors exactly.
forecast.assumption: A stationary iid annual opportunity mixture is a forecasting approximation. Synthetic scenario independence does not imply annual independence, stationarity or real-world validity. Annual rows are integration support, not additional independent inferential trials.
forecast.joint: Retain each three-asset return vector. Common inflation cancels from log action comparisons under this exogenous return model; realized real wealth and historical MDD always use actual inflation.
forecast.no_online_fit: No updates from the current investor history and no future rows of the evaluated scenario enter forecast fitting. Current holdings and known remaining horizon are the only live state.

bellman.state: u=x/sum(x), nonnegative and sums to 1; h remaining periods. No deposits, withdrawals or terminal liquidation.
bellman.actions: hold actual holdings or restore one approved fixed target w. Target does not change over the horizon.
bellman.fee: rho comes from execute_target(u,w,c), once, including initial allocation when chosen.
bellman.selection: Take trade only if approximate Qtrade-Qhold>1e-12 and the current weights differ from the target. Otherwise hold. No positive policy margin or confidence multiplier is tuned.
bellman.initial: The gate applies at t=0 as well; initial investment is optional for the prototype, unlike the mandatory initial allocation in the annual and buy-and-hold comparisons. Record initial trade frequency explicitly.
bellman.horizon: Use h=H-t at each decision and run each client horizon separately; DP actions can depend on H. A 30-year path prefix is not a 5-year DP policy.
bellman.risk: This is a growth Bellman prototype, not a risk-constrained Bellman optimizer. It does not carry peak/drawdown risk budgets; full executed-path diagnostics must be reported and original suitability must not be inherited.

numerics.interpolation: Deterministic triangular simplex barycentric interpolation, with nonnegative weights summing to 1; no projection of actual holdings in simulation.
numerics.online_hold: Evaluate the current empirical expected log return exactly and interpolate only future V via direct current-state transition. Do not interpolate grid Qhold as economic gain; that can spuriously favor a trade even at h=1 due to concavity.
numerics.optimality: Backward recursion solves the specified approximate transition model. No claim of exact continuous-state optimality or bounded solver error without evidence.
numerics.resolution: Repeat same fixed-target experiment at both resolutions; report changes in initial modeled V, action disagreement on common visited states if available, actual paired G/MDD/cost/trade frequency and client exceedance counts. Do not choose the more flattering mesh.
numerics.no_monte_carlo: Finite empirical expectation integration; no 256 forecast paths or seed-based approximation.

policies.annual_restore: Frozen-target annual restoration, with mandatory initial allocation and exact costs.
policies.initial_then_hold: Frozen-target mandatory initial allocation, then no later transfers.
policies.myopic_gate: The same forecast and exact fee, with h=1 at every review; the gate applies initially too. A diagnostic of myopia, not a selected policy.
policies.finite_horizon_gate: The same forecast and target, current actual u and true remaining H; direct-transition approximate Bellman evaluation.
policies.equal_weight_annual: Exact one-third target, annual restoration including the initial fee, at the same cost.

evaluation.full: Training-context descriptive outcome, not external performance.
evaluation.folds: Use the already declared five 96/24 whole-scenario folds. Refit the forecast and Bellman solution separately on each set of 96; use its already frozen annual-menu targets. Do not refit targets or menus on the 24 evaluation paths. This evaluates a fixed-target execution ablation, not a newly optimized complete service.
evaluation.metrics: At H=5,6,15,25,30 and each client's own H,L, report G, median/P10 net real CAGR, median/P90 MDD, CVaR90, ordinary annual volatility, expected excess and exact breach counts; report costs and trade frequency with explicitly named denominators.
evaluation.referrals: Keep original full/fold assignments and Review frozen; Review financial outcomes remain NULL. No adviser response or fallback is invented.
evaluation.actions: Record pretrade u, h, selected action, modeled Q difference, exact fee/moved amount, current one-period expected gain and paired realized next-year gain computed only after the decision. A modeled net continuation gain is not a guaranteed realized benefit.
evaluation.uncertainty: No per-action 95% claim, pooled OOF certificate or final selection. The finite-family CP1160 bound from the static annual study cannot be reused for data-learned dynamic policies.

protocol.later_cost_probe: Only after numerical and causality audits, optionally repeat the fixed design at 0 and .005 with the new known cost in accounting and Bellman evaluation; changing the cost input is not margin retuning. No policy winner is chosen.
required_checks: Pure unit tests of the simplex, stochastic operator, H=1 off-mesh direct enumeration and identity/scale.
Constructed H=2 gain recovers the amortization counterexample.
Independent H=2 exact scenario-tree enumeration on small synthetic empirical support to bound interpolation error.
Annual and buy-and-hold branches match the already verified cache/ablation exactly.
Future-perturbation causality: the evaluated scenario suffix cannot change earlier actions under a frozen model.
Source/input/output start/end hashes; guarded scenarios 1--120 only.

independent_synthetic_tree_audit.scope: Small synthetic numerical audit; not a global error bound, lower bound or market-risk certificate

scope: Exploratory frozen-target execution comparison; no menu/assignment/risk-budget refitting, winner selection or static finite-family CP guarantee for the learned dynamic rule
referrals: Original Review retains null financial outcomes and coverage denominator; no equal-weight fallback. Equal-weight annual is target-level reference only.
forecast: Full 120 or fold 96 training scenarios, every original joint annual gross; equal original-scenario and year weights. Annual support points are not independent inferential observations.
true_horizon: Each H simulated afresh from initial all-bill 100; finite decision_h=H-t, myopic decision_h=1. Initial gate is optional, fixed annual/hold initial allocation mandatory.
deduplication: Only exactly repeated (actual u,h,target ID) rows are deduplicated. No state projection, quantization or grid-Q interpolation in online actions.
trace_axes: Each dynamic trace=(scenario,target,year1..H), pretrade_weights adds asset axis. IDs identify each evaluation context. fee_fraction is actual, hypothetical_fee_fraction is the cost of restoring whether selected or not.
trace_gains: gain=net modeled Qtrade-Qhold; one_period_gain=exact empirical restore-vs-hold expected net log increment. restore_realized_paired_gain is computed after the action using realized gross, with fee once. selected_action_realized_gain is zero if hold is selected. No gain is a guaranteed future benefit.
model_value_units: Initial approximate decision V/Q factors are nominal log-wealth factors under the annual mixture, not exact realized gains or lower bounds. initial_decision_h=H for finite horizon, but 1 for myopic: the latter is not an H-period policy forecast. Realized performance uses net real wealth and client H. Common inflation cancels from paired action differences, not realized risk.
resolution: Both meshes retained. Common visited states mean exactly identical numerical u on paired trajectories; all-path-year action disagreement also includes trajectory drift. Neither statistic proves a continuous-state error bound.
pairing: Alternative minus annual at each original path and frozen target before aggregation; no bootstrap confidence or OOF pooled certificate.
cost_units: Cumulative nominal fees/moved are accounting amounts. Annual fee/moved fractions use pretrade wealth; moved_to_initial_wealth uses fixed100. These are not return percentage points.
